st_area_members_hint: Who has access, with which roles and permissions.
mb_roles_hint: Several roles at once; their permissions add up.
mb_subject_hint: Filled in when you pick the person from the search. Cannot find them? Invite them by e-mail.
mb_search_hint: A name or an e-mail address, at least two letters. Only the team's accounts are shown, never clients'.
mb_search_none: Nobody in the team for “{q}”. You can invite them by e-mail.
mb_search_unavailable: The search is not answering right now. Try again, or invite the person by e-mail.
mb_invite_text: We make their sign-in account, add them to the team with the roles chosen and e-mail them the console's address.
mb_invited_created: We made {name}'s account and e-mailed them. If the e-mail does not arrive, send them the link below: it lets them set their password. It works once and expires soon; after that they choose “Forgot password” on the sign-in page.
mb_invited_existing: {name} already had an account: they are in the team now and have been e-mailed. They sign in as they usually do.
mb_invited_nolink: We made {name}'s account and e-mailed them. The set-password link could not be made right now: they choose “Forgot password” on the sign-in page.
mb_invited_once: The link is shown only now: we keep it nowhere.
mb_invite_conflict: Not invited: the address is a client's, the account is switched off, or the person is already in the team.
mb_invite_unavailable: Not invited: the sign-in account cannot be made right now. Try again later.
mb_link_hint: For someone who has never signed in: the invitation's link expired or the e-mail did not arrive.
mb_link_text: Send {name} the link below: it lets them set their password. It works once and expires soon; links made before no longer work.
mb_link_conflict: No link made: the person has already signed in (they reset their own password), has no e-mail, or their account is no longer in the team.
mb_link_unavailable: No link made: the sign-in is not answering right now. Try again later.
jr_s_member_link: Made a new set-password link for: {object}
jr_s_member_invite: Invited to the team by e-mail: {object}
mb_effective: What they can do, in all
mb_effective_hint: Every role together, with the extra permissions and without the withdrawn ones.
mb_extra_hint: Given to this person only, on top of their roles.
mb_withdrawn_hint: Withdrawn from this person only: a withdrawn permission is not received from any role, nor as an extra permission.
mb_removed: The person was removed from the team.
mb_problem: The change was not made: check the details.
mb_self: You cannot change your own roles and permissions.
mb_readonly: You can see the team, but not change it.
mb_remove_title: Remove the person from the team?
mb_remove_text: {name} loses access: their roles and individual permissions go.
jr_s_member_add: Added to the team: {object}, with the roles: {roles}
